title: BEYOND SCALAR REWARD MODEL: LEARNING GENERATIVE JUDGE FROM PREFERENCE DATA
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of training a generative judge to replace scalar reward models in LLM alignment. While it uses safety-oriented benchmarks like PKU-SafeRLHF and Reward-Bench for evaluation, it does not specifically investigate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral philosophy, or theology as a core component of the research.
